# Evidence (all numbers regenerated by `python -m kestrel_router.evaluate`)

## 1. The labels are the bot's queue, not the right answer
- `team_label` equals the team that finally closed the request only **77.2%** of the time (renamed teams treated as the same team).
- A model trained to copy `team_label` scores ~96% against `team_label` but only ~76.5% against what really happened. It passes Ritu's 90% test while being exactly as wrong as the bot.
- Requests that needed >=1 transfer: 24.9%; average handling cost per request today: Rs 175.

## 3. Confidence gate: auto-route the sure ones, show a person the rest
Average cost of one wrong routing in the log: Rs 685. Volume: ~726/month.

| Threshold | Share auto-routed | Accuracy on those | Monthly cost if a human check costs Rs 150 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.0 | 100.0% | 83.7% | Rs 80,804 |
| 0.5 | 83.8% | 95.0% | Rs 38,373 |
| 0.6 | 81.2% | 95.8% | Rs 37,453 |
| 0.7 | 80.0% | 96.6% | Rs 35,235 |
| 0.8 | 79.0% | 97.2% | Rs 34,029 |

Today's bot: Rs 126,864/month in transfer + extra-contact cost, plus the licence Rs 26,667/month.

## 4. Data problems found
- `product_family` disagrees with the product named in the text in **17.5%** of rows that name one product. The field is unreliable; the model ignores it (adding it did not improve accuracy).
- `transfers` contradicts first/final team: 351 rows show transfers but the same team, 126 rows show 0 transfers but different teams.
- Legacy Zoho `resolved_at` is stored in UTC: 26.4% of legacy rows 'resolve' before they were created (IST/UTC offset). Not used as a feature.
- Broken characters in 4.4% of all rows (11.1% of legacy). Cleaned in `text.py`.
- 92 identical text+product combinations ended in different teams: some requests are genuinely unroutable from text alone.
- Team names changed on 15 Jan 2026; train contains both. Merged for training.
- `resolution_log` exists only for train and describes the future of each request; used as the target, never as a feature.
